- **Text baseline has high lead but high FPR**: Text detects early (+9.8/+10.3 steps) but at cost of 20-26% pre-CP FPR and low precision (42-47%). Many "early detections" are false positives.
- **HS Static LR is conservative**: Best precision (69.3%) and lowest FPR (9.7%) but crosses late (lead=-2.0) and low coverage (46.5%).
- **HS Temporal LR W=5 best balance**: 82% acc, 67% coverage, +0.6 lead, 10.2% FPR, 68.6% precision.
- **GRU has highest coverage (73%) and lead (+4.5)** but trades off FPR (16.5%) and precision (62.2%). High variance across seeds.
- **Coverage definition note**: Coverage counts traces where probe crosses threshold (not necessarily at/before CP). For the hidden state methods, most crossings happen near CP.
